thread.title: BMO Capital Believes CGI Group Cl A SV (GIB.A) Won’t Stop Here

author: Howard Kim
title: BMO Capital Believes CGI Group Cl A SV (GIB.A) Won’t Stop Here
text:
Howard Kim - January 16, 2019, 2:09 PM EDT SHARE ON:
Today, an analyst has provided a rating update for CGI Group Cl A SV ( GIB.A ). The company received a Buy rating from BMO Capital’s analyst Thanos Moschopoulos , with a C$94 price target.
According to TipRanks.com , Moschopoulos is a 2-star analyst with an average return of 0.0% and a 59.7% success rate. Moschopoulos covers the Technology sector, focusing on stocks such as Maxar Technologies Ltd, CGI Group, and Open Text.
Read also: Apple (AAPL) Is Still a C$200 Stock, Says Wedbush
Currently, the analyst consensus on CGI Group Cl A SV is a Strong Buy with an average price target of C$93.06, an 8.1% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 8, Raymond James also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a C$94 price target.
.
The company has a one-year high of C$87.22 and a one-year low of C$66.37. Currently, CGI Group Cl A SV has an average volume of 628.7K.
CGI Group, Inc. engages in the provision of information technology (IT) and consulting services. It operates through the following segments: Northern Europe, Canada, France, U.S. Commercial and State Government, U.S. Federal, U.K., Eastern, Central and Southern Europe (ECS), and Asia Pacific Global Delivery Centers of Excellence (APC).
The company’s shares closed on Wednesday at C$86.11, close to its 52-week high of C$87.22. More GIB.A Research at TipRanks
